title: Instrumentation Sketchpad: KV-prefetch & Metric Ontology Experiment
content:
Purpose:
Quick lab notebook for a small instrumentation experiment: measure the effect of proactive KV-prefetch on tail latency and cost per token, and record a compact metric ontology that will be used by dashboards and tracing. This is an early sketch — treat as living notes.

Summary of hypothesis:
- Prefetching likely reduces TTFB for multi-hop prompts in ~30% of sessions where the prefix is stable across calls.
- Prefetching increases write/ingest telemetry but should lower user-visible tail latencies and SLO violations when hit ratio > 0.25.
- We need a small, clear metric set + trace span conventions to validate and debug.

Metric definitions (candidate set):
- inference.requests.total: count of inbound requests (label: route, model, tier).
- inference.tokens.generated: tokens produced per request (route, model, truncated).
- kv.prefetch.attempts: number of prefetch attempts (label: reason=canary|heuristic).
- kv.prefetch.hits: successful prefetches that were used in subsequent calls.
- kv.prefetch.latency.ms.p50/p95/p99: end-to-end prefetch latency distribution.
- inference.tokenttfb.ms.p50/p95/p99: time to first token for requests (important to correlate with kv hits).
- inference.slo.violations: boolean counter for requests exceeding SLO threshold (default 200ms TTFB).
- telemetry.ingest.cost.units: approximate ingestion cost metric (for tradeoff analysis).

Metric semantics notes (short):
- All token and latency metrics should be aggregated with route and model labels. Avoid adding user_id at cardinality-sensitive rollups; use tenant bucket for multi-tenant checks.
- prefetched spans should carry a prefetch_id to link with later inference spans (see tracing conventions).

Tracing conventions (proto):
- Root span: inference.request (tags: route, model, request_id).
- Child span: prefetch.operation (tags: prefetch_id, source_hint, attempt_id, cache_candidate_key).
- Child span: kv.lookup (tags: backend_shard, key_count).
- Child span: response.stream (tags: first_token_offset).
- Linkage: if prefetch.operation exists, inference.request should include prefetch_id as trace tag. When prefetch operation is used to satisfy KV, add annotation prefetch.used = true.
- Sampling: weight traces with prefetch.used=true higher (5x) for first 2 weeks of experiment to get debugging coverage.

Dashboard wireframe notes (compact):
- Top row: small KPI panel with requests.total, tokenttfb.p95, slo.violations. Toggle by route/model.
- Middle: prefetch funnel: attempts -> hits -> used-in-response ratio; show hit-rate over sliding 1h/24h windows.
- Right: cost panel: ingest.cost (estimate) vs token cost saved (model-specific).
- Bottom: trace-sample explorer (linked traces filtered by prefetch.used=true and tokenttfb.p99 spikes).
- UX: add small switch to collapse-by-tenant to debug noisy clients.

Experiment plan (minimal steps):
1) Instrument prefetch attempt and hit metrics + tracing in a feature-flagged branch.
2) Start with canary traffic (5% of requests on a single low-traffic route) for 48 hours.
3) Ramp to 20% if p99 TTFB improves and SLO violations do not increase.
4) Collect cost delta and operator feedback; revert if errors or TTL invalidations increase.

Acceptance criteria for success:
- p95 TTFB reduced by >= 12% for the canaried route without increasing error rate or SLO violations.
- Prefetch.used ratio >= 0.25 and stable for 24h.
- Net token cost per 1000 requests decreases or stays within 5% of baseline.

Open questions / risks:
- Cardinality: prefetch_id will add trace cardinality; mitigate by short-lived ids and sample prioritization.
- Privacy: ensure prefetch keys never expose PII — need review from security.
- Eviction noise: prefetch may pollute KV; track kv.evictions.by-prefetch to monitor.

Operational checklist (short):
- Add metric alarms: tokenttfb.p99 increase > 20% triggers immediate rollback.
- Add runbook snippet: how to disable prefetch flag for a route.
- Ensure dashboard tokens are sampled to avoid runaway query cost.

Notes to self (todo / scratch):
- Quick SQL for hit-rate: SELECT sum(kv_prefetch_hits)/sum(kv_prefetch_attempts) by tenant, 1h window.
- Add conftest to validate label sets on metrics before merge.
- Coordinate with product to choose the first route: suggestions: chat-short, api-summary.

References and links:
- Confluence canvas link above; PR #482 has initial metric names and proto changes.
- JIRA-OBS-1207 tracks rollout and security review.

Rough timeline:
- Instrumentation + PR: 3 days.
- Canary + 48h observation: 2 days.
- Ramp/analysis: 3–5 days.

End of sketchpad. Keep this doc as the live ingest for decisions; I'll convert to a shorter playbook if results look promising.

-- Aisha
